known_parity_gaps: GAP-cli-init-create-parser: Python create_parser() returns an argparse.ArgumentParser with subcommands; Rust create_parser() stops with sesslint.cli.check.configure is not available and does not register subparsers.
GAP-cli-init-parse-args: Python main() calls parser.parse_args; Rust stops with argparse.ArgumentParser.parse_args is not available.
GAP-cli-init-print-help: Python _dispatch with no command calls parser.print_help; Rust returns argparse.ArgumentParser.print_help is not available.
GAP-cli-init-dispatch-runtime: Python _dispatch runs build_context, preflight, and command.run; Rust stops at sesslint.config.load_config and registry Command::run seams.
GAP-cli-init-textio-reconfigure: Python main() reconfigure(encoding=utf-8) on TextIOWrapper streams; Rust has no reconfigure seam.
GAP-cli-init-load-session-file: Python load_session_file aliases api.validate_session; Rust does not export that alias.

GAP-cli-init-format-membership: Python _removed_flag_hint imports sesslint.adapters.VALID_FORMAT_OPTIONS for --format <adapter>; Rust returns sesslint.adapters.VALID_FORMAT_OPTIONS is not available without copying the token.
